capabilities: create Basic, Reversible, Cloze, List, Dump, and Image Occlusion cards from Markdown markers
synchronize note edits, moves, and renames to Anki while preserving scheduling and review history
queue mobile card operations in an outbox processed by desktop Obsidian via file sync
render embeds, Canvas, PDF, Excalidraw, and chart blocks into portable Anki media
review and confirm pending deletions and resolve missing-note conflicts
extras: Versions before 1.0.0 used the plugin ID obsidian-anki-bridge; the current version migrates the old registry, settings, and outbox. When syncing the vault across devices, the README recommends separate Obsidian configuration folders per device so device-specific settings do not overwrite the shared registry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into Anki flashcards that stay in sync without writing generated IDs into the Markdown or losing review history.

relations.evidence: On desktop, the plugin connects to a running Anki application through AnkiConnect.
Excalidraw drawings and other visual file embeds rendered through their Obsidian plugin when that plugin is installed

summary: Creates and updates Anki flashcards from Markdown markers, syncing edits while preserving Anki scheduling and review history, with a mobile outbox workflow.
